PRODUCT DATA SHEET: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: PRODUCT DATA SHEET, edition not printed (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika_primer-207.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide PRODUCT DATA SHEET where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (edition not printed).
1.2 Product description. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).
1.3 Intended uses. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. PRODUCT DATA SHEET
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - CQP001-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > PRODUCT DATA SHEET (p.1).

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (edition not printed) and the requirements below.

    | Sika® Primer-207 is a solvent-based black primer which reacts with moisture and forms a thin layer. This layer acts as a link between substrates and adhesives. Sika® Primer-207 is specifically formulated for the treatment of bond faces prior to application of Sika’s 1-component Polyurethanes. This primer might provide excellent adhesion without previous activation step on many substrates. Sika® Primer-207 fluoresces under long-wave UV light for a limited period of time. This feature is used for in-process control. | Enhanced adhesion on a wide variety of substrates Visible under UV light Easy to use |
    | METHOD OF APPLICATION |
    | Surfaces must be clean, dry and free from grease, oil, dust and contaminants. |
    | Adhesion on substrates may be improved by adding and/or combining pre-treatment processes such as scuffing, cleaning and activating. |

    CQP = Corporate Quality Procedure A) for specific application, temperature and flash-off time may be different B) stored in sealed container in up-right position in a dry place ≤ 25 °C
    AREAS OF APPLICATION Sika® Primer-207 is used to improve adhesion on a very broad range of different substrates such as float glass, ceramic-coated glass, plastics, pre-coatings, painted surfaces, Ecoats and metals. Seek manufacturer’s advice and perform tests on original substrates before using Sika® Primer-207 on materials prone to stress cracking. This product is suitable for experienced professional users only. Tests with actual substrates and conditions have to be performed to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.

Users must always refer to the most recent issue of the local Product Data Sheet for the product concerned, copies of which will be supplied on request.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: PRODUCT DATA SHEET, edition not printed, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika_primer-207.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Primer-207, version 20/12/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/Sika%20Primer%20207%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
